caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden high chair against a plain, light beige background. The high chair is constructed from brown wood with visible grain and features several distinct parts: a backrest with a curved top edge, three vertical slats beneath the horizontal top rail, and two gracefully curved armrests that are supported by turned wooden posts. The seat is flat with a slight wave along its front edge. The chair has a footrest bar running horizontally between the front legs, which are splayed outward for stability and connected by horizontal crossbars. The high chair's wood has a reddish-brown hue, and no additional objects or background elements are present in the drawing.
title: Child's High Chair
